children: Bank of Japan board member Ayano Sato said she supports the idea of raising interest rates in several stages as current financial conditions were accommodative, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday.
Appointed by dovish Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, Sato was among two dissenters to the BOJ's decision to raise interest rates in September.
